### Janus Living Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Guidance


November 2, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/993969851/files/doc_news/Janus-Living-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-and-Increases-Full-Year-2026-Guidance-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Janus Living, Inc. (NYSE: JAN) (“Janus Living”), a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT), announced results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE AND RECENT HIGHLIGHTS** (all percentage changes compare third quarter 2026 to third quarter 2025 unless otherwise noted)


- Net loss of $(0.02) per share
- FFO as Adjusted of $0.25 per share increased 46%
- Consolidated revenues of $268 million increased 78% and Adjusted EBITDAre of $105 million increased 101%
- Same-store adjusted NOI increased 25.9% and margin expanded 360 basis points (“bps”)


- Same-store revenues increased 9.8% driven by 300 bps of average occupancy growth and 6.5% revenue per occupied room (“RevPOR”) growth


- Record third quarter non-refundable entrance fee sales of $47 million
- Acquired 33 senior housing communities for approximately $1.75 billion


- From July 1 through August 3, as previously disclosed, completed approximately $1.0 billion of senior housing acquisitions
- From August 4 through September 30, completed approximately $743 million of senior housing acquisitions


- Subsequent to quarter end and through October 30, completed approximately $370 million of senior housing acquisitions
- Year-to-date as of October 30, completed approximately $2.9 billion of senior housing acquisitions
- Under binding purchase agreements for approximately $82 million of incremental senior housing acquisitions
- Completed a follow-on offering of Class A-1 common stock generating approximately $513 million in net proceeds to pursue acquisition and investment opportunities
- Upsized unsecured revolving credit facility to $1.25 billion and terminated the prior $100 million unsecured delayed-draw term loan
- As of October 30, the Company had approximately $1.2 billion of liquidity including unrestricted cash and available credit facility capacity

**SENIOR HOUSING TRANSACTIONS AND PIPELINE**


From July 1 through August 3, 2026, as previously disclosed, we completed approximately $1.0 billion of senior housing acquisitions across six transactions with six different operating partners for 18 communities. The acquisitions represent 2,475 units on a combined basis.


From August 4 through September 30, 2026, we completed approximately $743 million of senior housing acquisitions across five transactions with four different operating partners for 15 communities. The acquisitions represent 1,432 units on a combined basis.


Subsequent to quarter end and through October 30, 2026, we completed a total of approximately $370 million of senior housing acquisitions across three transactions with three different operating partners for six communities. The acquisitions represent 792 units on a combined basis.


The acquisitions will be operated by leading operators well known to Janus Living under management contracts with strong alignment. Janus Living is targeting low-6% year 1 cash NOI yields and 7.5% to 8.5% yields upon stabilization across these investments.


Janus Living has an additional $82 million of senior housing acquisitions under binding purchase agreements anticipated to close during the fourth quarter of 2026 at returns consistent with previous acquisitions. The Company continues to see compelling and accretive investment opportunities.


**AUGUST FOLLOW-ON OFFERING**


In August 2026, Janus Living completed a follow-on offering of its Class A-1 common stock generating approximately $513 million in net proceeds. Janus Living utilized the net proceeds received from the offering to complete acquisitions that met its investment criteria and for general corporate purposes.


**BALANCE SHEET**


As previously disclosed, in September 2026, Janus Living upsized its unsecured revolving credit facility to $1.25 billion.


The credit facility increases the existing total commitments from $600 million to $1.25 billion by increasing the revolving commitments by $750 million and terminating the prior $100 million unsecured delayed-draw term loan. The credit facility initially matures in March 2030 and may be extended pursuant to two six-month extension options.


Borrowings under the credit facility will continue to bear interest at SOFR plus 105 basis points based on Janus Living’s current leverage-based pricing grid, and carries a facility fee on the entire revolving commitment of 15 basis points per annum. The credit facility was undrawn at closing.


As of September 30, 2026, the Company had approximately $338 million of unrestricted cash and no outstanding debt.


As of October 30, 2026, the Company had approximately $1.2 billion of liquidity including unrestricted cash and available credit facility capacity.


**DIVIDEND**


On September 11, 2026, Janus Living's Board of Directors declared a monthly common stock cash dividend of $0.0475 per share for the fourth quarter of 2026, payable on the payment dates set forth in the table below to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the corresponding record date in the table below. The monthly dividend reflects an annualized dividend amount of $0.57 per share of common stock. Future dividends are at the discretion of Janus Living's Board of Directors.

**ABOUT JANUS LIVING**


Janus Living, Inc. is a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns high-quality communities across the United States that support residents with thoughtfully designed, highly amenitized environments.


**NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES**


Nareit FFO, FFO as Adjusted, Same-Store Adjusted NOI, Adjusted EBITDAre, and Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDAre are supplemental non-GAAP financial measures that we believe are useful in evaluating the operating performance and financial position of real estate investment trusts. See “September 30, 2026 Discussion and Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for definitions, discussions of their uses and inherent limitations, and reconciliations to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated and presented in accordance with GAAP, available in the Investor Relations section of our website at[https://ir.janusreit.com/financials/quarterly-results](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.janusreit.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results&esheet=54633276&newsitemid=20261102680911&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.janusreit.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results&index=4&md5=d602269d47c1aaab51bd2035e3e162a4) .
